name: Full Beer Model
description: Original SDMR Full Beer Model reconstructed from native Vensim equations. Restores all18 INTEG balances, missing R_ALPHA and six expectation-adjustment flows, corrects generic-block stock links, and retains declaration aliases without double-counting physical flows. All original IDs/nodes/layout retained; no new demand coupling invented where the source only declares a potential dependency.
reference: Duggan J. System Dynamics Modeling with R. Full Beer Model.mdl, SDMR revision89bbfe65c25db5bcca511c10ef6527c8ebe35696. Original18 stock derivatives and six standalone inventory/expectation blocks restored; A FUNCTION OF declaration nodes retained only as informational aliases.
